usage.title: Follow along: from idea to launch in four steps
usage.description: Not sure where to start? Follow these four steps — what to use at each one is ready for you here.

items.title: Step 1: Figure out what to build
items.description: First get clear on what kind of site you want and who it's for. We help you find ideas and see how others did it.

items.title: Step 2: Design and build
items.description: Pick ready-made UI templates and component kits instead of designing from scratch; paired with AI coding tools, you can build it with little code.

items.title: Step 3: Add features and AI
items.description: Need login, data storage (a database), payments, or an AI model? We have compared the services so you know which to use.

items.title: Step 4: Launch and grow
items.description: Deploy your site, then do SEO (so people can find you on Google) — the tools you need are all sorted here.

faq.title: Questions beginners often ask
faq.description: Worried you can't pull it off? Read these first.

items.title: I can't code at all — can I still use this?
items.description: Yes. This is made for people who aren't very technical. It tells you what to use at each step, and many parts can be done with AI tools, so you don't have to write code from scratch.

items.title: How do I get started?
items.description: If you have a clear goal, browse the tools and templates by step. If you're not sure yet, tell the AI assistant your idea and it will tell you roughly what you need.

items.title: Does any of this cost money?
items.description: Browsing resources, reading articles, and asking the AI are all free. For the recommended tools themselves, we mark which are free and which are paid, so you choose as needed.

items.title: Is the AI assistant reliable, or does it make things up?
items.description: It answers only from real site content and gives sources. If nothing relevant exists on the site, it simply says it can't find it, rather than inventing an answer.
